text:
Anya - Onboarding: Kickoff for Rivermark dedicated pool commissioning — 11:00am PT. Quick agenda: quota mapping, autoscale policy, priming/runbook, loadtest windows, and post-run feedback capture. @Maria any renewal/health flags to call out before we start?
Maria - Customer Success: Renewal in Oct but health dipped after last week's latency spikes. They were worried about cold starts and token cost. Suggested: aggressive priming for first 48h and a soft-burn traffic ramp.
Josh - Solutions Eng: I'll own quota mapping and the priming script. Plan: map their 3 tenant tiers -> our reserved pool partitions, set per-tenant qps caps in routing. Sharing the priming command I'll run on my laptop:
```
./prime.sh --pool rp-09872 --model redwood-3b-q8 --prefixes-file prefixes.txt --duration 2h
```
Liam - SRE: Infra notes: reserved pool rp-09872 provisioned by infra (see deploy-bot msg). We'll configure autoscale: min_nodes=2, max_nodes=8, target_gpu_util=70%, scale_cooldown=300s. Also enabling region-fallback: eu-west -> us-west. Any objections to those numbers?
Rae - Account Exec: Customer asked for a soft start (no more than 40% of expected peak) for first 72h and a daily sync with them. They want the initial cost estimate baked into the onboarding docs.
deploy-bot: Reserved pool created: pool_id=rp-09872, region=us-west-2, initial_nodes=4 (gpus=8), image=redwood-infer:stable-2026-03-18
Anya - Onboarding: Proposed loadtest schedule: smoke test 2:00pm PT (50 RPS, 30m), ramp verification 4:00pm PT (120 RPS, 1h), full soak 6:00pm PT (200 RPS, 2h) with the soft-start constraint for first 72h. Who will trigger and watch metrics?
Josh - Solutions Eng: I'll trigger the load tests and watch QPS/latency traces. Load recipe (locust-like):
```
loadrunner --target https://api.redwood.local/ --concurrency 100 --rps 200 --duration 2h --headers 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'
```
I'll tag runs with rivermark-2026-03-18 so we can correlate in console.
Liam - SRE: I'll set up dashboard panels for token-level cost, p95 latency, GPU util, and KF cache hit rate. Alerting thresholds: p95 > 600ms OR GPU util < 30% for 3m -> paging. Also will enable auto-fallback policy to the hosted fallback pool if errors > 1% sustained for 5m.
Maria - Customer Success: Post-run ask: capture their subjective quality feedback using the short survey link and paste any quote here. I'll own the customer-facing summary and renewal touchpoint.
Rae - Account Exec: I'll block a 30-min debrief tomorrow morning with customer and solutions. Expecting to discuss warmup outcomes and billing.
Anya - Onboarding: Quick checklist for today (tick when done): 1) Quota partitions configured (Josh) 2) Autoscale policy applied (Liam) 3) Priming script executed (Josh) 4) Smoke & soak runs (Josh + Liam) 5) Customer soft-start confirmed (Rae) 6) Feedback survey + debrief scheduled (Maria/Rae).
Josh - Solutions Eng: Starting priming in 15m. Will paste run-id and basic metrics here.
deploy-bot: Canaries scheduled: canary-job=canary-rm-03, start=2026-03-18T18:00:00Z, replicas=2
Liam - SRE: Noted — I'll be on watch during the full soak. If we see >2% 5xx, we'll cut traffic back to 20% and investigate.
Maria - Customer Success: Thanks all — please paste any run ids, console links, and short customer comments in this thread so I can synthesize for renewal/health notes. :thumbsup:
